s: We proclaim what we have seen and touched, the Word of life. God is light. If we confess our sins, he forgives.
Christ is our advocate. Whoever loves his brother lives in the light.
See what love the Father has given us, that we should be called children of God.
Test the spirits. God is love, and perfect love casts out fear.
Faith overcomes the world. Whoever has the Son has life.

3: The bowels were thought of as the seat of feeling. Here: the heart, deep compassion.
